updates.description: Complete authorized specs/docs files to write. Mission, Task, trigger, path authority, validation, commit policy, timestamps and source-event references are derived by the Host.

document.description: Task-authorized path below specs/ or docs/.

purpose.description: Why this Task requires the document update.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 document text for an ordinary-sized update. Use contentArtifactIds instead for a document staged in chunks.

contentArtifactIds.description: Ordered artifact IDs returned by military_specs_stage_chunk. Use this instead of content, never together with content.
